data.title: About referrals.
items: Do I need to be a Catch host to refer someone?
No. Anyone can refer a host.
Credit is earned when the host pays a Catch bill. Each credit is checked and approved, then paid [monthly, by UPI].
10% of what the host pays Catch, before GST. Catch’s fee is 5% of their sales, capped at ₹10,000 a month, so the most one host can earn you is ₹1,000 a month.
What if the host was already talking to Catch?
Credit goes to the first referral we record for that host. If they’d already contacted us, there’s no credit.
Will you tell the host I referred them?
Yes, we’ll say you sent us, unless you’d rather we didn’t. Tell us in the form.
What if they don’t claim their page in time?
The referral lapses after 90 days, and no credit is earned for that host.
